decision.factual_verdict: The literal universal claim that lightning never strikes the same place twice is contradicted for the ordinary same-object/location reading.
decision.scope: NOAA directly rebuts the literal claim. Tower measurement evidence supports repeated interaction with a fixed structure; it does not turn every recorded tower flash into downward cloud-to-ground lightning.
decision.limitations: No exact mathematical-coordinate identity, ordinary-ground recurrence probability, precise annual rate, personal-strike claim or idiom adjudicated.

findings.target: draft Scope line and supplement proposed widening
findings.text: Do not silently replace the original downward/cloud-to-ground scope with all tower attachments. Either keep the original scope with NOAA explanatory evidence and make the tower study separate context, or publish a separately authored/versioned broader fixed-structure claim with an explicit transformation map and fresh review.

findings.target: draft proposed consumer answer and evidence labels
findings.text: Prefer a count-free answer. If building rates remain, identify each source's differing assertion and absent methods/period; about-two-dozen is a summary of claims, not a newly verified annual rate. Record tower totals only with their period, event unit and direction qualifier. Multiple return strokes in one flash are not multiple independent flashes.

Instrumented conference-paper content is accessible, but complete measurement validation and peer-review status were not established. Record browser text access separately from failed live PDF retrieval; do not claim fresh raw-PDF verification or recovered historical bytes.

findings.target: draft and supplement source independence claims
findings.text: NWS and NSSL share NOAA origin; independent textual wording does not create two independent empirical lines. ESB organizational separation does not establish data independence. ALDIS paper and project page are one project lineage. Reviewer ownership diversity is a separate relationship disclosure.

proposed_scope_split.scope_limits: Everyday location/object, not identical mathematical coordinates; retain NSSL near-spot qualifier. No quantified recurrence odds.
